dct_title_s: A new Map of Africa Designed by Mounſir Sanſon, Geographr to the French King. Rendered into Engliſh and Illuſtrated with Figurs by Richard Blome by the Kings Eſpeciall Command
dct_description_sm: Similar to Sanson's map (see NOR 0035). Blome added ships, sea monsters and the dedication to the Right Honourable Charles Howard.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0042, p. 52
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0042.
